description: vault.list answers every managed variable. A SECRET is listed by name, scope, flags and description and never its value: the type has no value to carry for it, so the omission is a shape and not a redaction. A plain variable carries its value because a person said it is not secret. `project` is a ROOT component id (an override for that project's work); absent means global.

variables.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.description: CI token for the github MCP server
